newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Purefoods to expand hog-raising operations.
newsitem.headline: Purefoods to expand hog-raising operations.

text.p: Purefoods Corp is investing 376.229 million pesos to expand its hog-raising operations, documents released on Monday by the Board of Investments showed.
Two farms will be set up in the northern Philippines with one nursing 4,000 sows and the other, 1,500 sows.
The farms will have the capability to produce a total of 94,500 heads every year.
Sales of the pigs raised in the farms will begin March next year.
Purefoods is the food subsidiary of conglomerate Ayala Corp.
